positioning: Infrastructure for evolutionary AI systems: generate, execute, evaluate, select and improve across digital and physical domains.
editorialPrinciples: Lead with the capability or research question, then explain mechanisms and evidence.
Explain each project’s distinct contribution to the ecosystem; do not imply that every project uses the same runtime or algorithm.
Separate the ecosystem vision from the scope demonstrated by an individual experiment.
Preserve concrete technical evidence, code, figures, original publication dates and source destinations.
Keep release notes useful as historical change records rather than turning maintenance updates into manifesto essays.
